title: Independent review of the k1 seven-cell and cross-core attachment notes
kind: Independent mathematical audit. Read-only except this review file. No solver, graph enumeration, catalogue scan, downloads, installs, Lean edits, formatters, linters, or test suites. The only computation run was exact integer arithmetic recounting stated scalar counts, which is within the permitted scalar-only checking the authors themselves performed.
scope_note: Both reviewed files are conditional research notes: every claim is a necessary-condition filter, an exact (if and only if) local/residual equivalence, or an exact labelled-partition statement. Neither file asserts exclusion or existence of an order-43 candidate. This review validates the internal mathematics and the exact/necessary labelling; it grants no pruning authority beyond what the proven statements give.

findings.title: Imprecise C5 step in the census-free e(F)>=10 sub-proof
findings.severity: proof gap at the initial revision; conclusion was correct but the written inference was not valid
findings.status: resolved; correction applied by the author and verified at the final hash f114df4f0999ce41f91b87c1fa73bb887ebd365df2fb1871957c62b749be86ce
findings.original_sentence: The independent cycle-neighbor sets of b,c must have union size at least3, since two common missed cycle vertices would form an I4 with b,c.
findings.problem: Two arbitrary commonly missed cycle vertices may be adjacent on the C5, in which case together with b,c they do not form an I4; the sentence as written does not establish union size at least 3 (its literal reading would rather suggest at least 4).
findings.required_and_applied_correction: The common missed cycle vertices of b,c must form a clique: otherwise b,c together with a nonadjacent commonly missed pair form an I4. Every clique in C5 has at most 2 vertices, so the union of the cycle-neighbor sets of b,c has size at least 3. Hence F has at least 2+5+3=10 edges.
findings.verification: Re-read the corrected line in full at the final hash; the argument is now valid (missed set clique by I4 obstruction, clique in C5 has at most 2 vertices, union >=3, edge count 2+5+3>=10) and the rest of the file was re-read against the audited revision with no other substantive change.
